in_marathi.name: Sashank
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Light
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sashank हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sashank is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sas' which means 'God' and 'Shank' which means 'Mountain'. The name Sashank signifies the God of Light and represents the wisdom of the mountains. It is also believed to symbolize the Sun God.
